n: Google and Adobe AI in the Classroom courses
t: Free teacher courses on AI literacy from Google and Adobe.
steps: Search for the Google AI Educator Series and open it.
Sign in with a Google account.
Complete a session and take the quiz.
Search for Generative AI in the Classroom with Adobe Express.
Sign in with an Adobe account.
Complete the course and save the badge or certificate.
Share one idea with your team.
